status_definitions.done: Critério de aceite comprovado por evidência registrada.
status_definitions.in_progress: Execução iniciada e ainda não validada.
status_definitions.ready: Executável autonomamente com as evidências atuais.
status_definitions.blocked_user: Exige uma ação explícita do usuário que o sistema não pode executar.
status_definitions.blocked_external: Exige aprovação, dispositivo, arquivo original ou capacidade de terceiro ainda indisponível.
status_definitions.accepted_gap: Limitação conhecida e contida, sem ação segura disponível agora.

release_gates: desktop and mobile browser tests for affected UI
fail-closed behavior for partial data failures
authenticated runtime check when real data behavior changes
public deploy smoke when the public app changes

reminder.reason: A date and time were not selected.

current_package.goal: Reconcile the delivered longitudinal product backlog and make the authenticated water handoff unambiguously notebook-first.

tasks.summary: Consolidate the recovered product brief without private health data.
acceptance: Product outcome, scope, source rules, trust rules, UX, privacy, and done criteria are documented.
The brief points to the operational ledger and specialized contracts.

tasks.summary: Create a durable, machine-readable execution ledger and restart protocol.
acceptance: Tasks have stable IDs, status, owner, acceptance criteria, evidence, next action, and blocker.
CI rejects missing required fields, duplicate IDs, invalid states, or executable work left behind.

tasks.summary: Allow the validated execution ledger through legacy privacy workflows without weakening their payload block.
acceptance: The only permitted payload-like public metadata file is v2/EXECUTION_STATE.json.
The allowlisted file is parsed and must declare public metadata scope with public health payloads disabled.
Both legacy main-branch workflows and the architecture workflow run the shared guard.

tasks.summary: Retry one proven transient local-navigation failure without masking deterministic browser contract failures.
acceptance: Only navigation timeout or local connection-refused signatures are eligible for one retry.
Assertion and other deterministic failures exit without retry.
Every architecture browser smoke uses the same runner.
evidence: GitHub Actions log for the transient nutrition page navigation timeout

tasks.summary: Make every primary water action open the historical batch import instead of the single-day form.
acceptance: Today, Nutrition, and Data direct the user to the historical importer.
The UI explicitly says that daily manual entry is unnecessary.
The single-day form remains available only as a secondary correction path.

tasks.summary: Reconcile legacy quality and source-request statements that contradict current structured evidence.
acceptance: Nutrition, workout normalization, and laboratory coverage issues are resolved only when same-owner evidence exists.
The laboratory request reflects partial structured coverage.
The historical water request is persisted and automatically completed by a valid authenticated import.
evidence: Supabase post-migration verification and rolled-back trigger probe

tasks.summary: Remove obsolete pre-promotion gates from the parity matrix.
acceptance: The matrix reflects the already promoted cockpit and authenticated desktop/mobile validation.
Future releases retain the current gates without claiming old work is pending.

tasks.summary: Reconcile the delivered cross-source longitudinal narrative with its external product backlog.
acceptance: Equivalent metrics are consolidated only by explicit per-metric rules without unsafe addition or duplication.
The weight series gives same-day priority to body composition and uses direct MyFitnessPal values only on other safe dates.
MyFitnessPal water absence in the old structured export is distinguished from the authenticated source, with audited batch transfer and import.
Laboratory trends require compatible marker, origin, unit, and unambiguous dates.
The UX follows summary, relevant change, trend, and detail with direct routes for deeper inspection.
Continuous and sparse domains use appropriate windows and every ambiguous path remains fail-closed.

tasks.summary: Make the MyFitnessPal historical-water handoff notebook-first and remove the misleading app-install interpretation.
acceptance: The helper leads with a notebook flow for Chrome, Edge, or Safari and explains that no app or extension is installed.
A phone user is told that nothing was started or lost and can copy the helper link for later.
Nutrition and the import modal consistently describe one automatic batch extraction rather than daily typing.
Extraction privacy, checkpoint, retry, and idempotent import contracts remain unchanged.

tasks.summary: Run the authenticated MyFitnessPal historical water export on a notebook and import the JSON into LTS Health.
acceptance: The extractor finishes the selected historical interval.
The LTS preview is confirmed and imports the generated JSON.
The private ledger changes to completed after a canonical MyFitnessPal water row with authenticated-export provenance is written.
tasks.next_action: On a notebook, open the public helper while signed in to MyFitnessPal, add/run the favorite, then import the generated JSON in LTS Health.
tasks.blocker: The authenticated MyFitnessPal session and local browser action belong to the user; credentials and cookies must not be transferred.

tasks.summary: Replace the user-triggered MyFitnessPal transfer with an official continuous connection if provider access becomes available.
acceptance: Official authorization is approved for the application.
Tokens remain server-side and sync is idempotent, observable, and revocable.
Water and nutrition provenance rules remain unchanged.
tasks.next_action: Reassess only when an official application credential and supported API scope are available.
tasks.blocker: Provider approval and supported API access are not available to this project.

tasks.summary: Validate the iOS HealthKit companion and water-source identity on a physical device.
acceptance: Signed build runs on a physical iPhone.
HealthKit permissions and source attribution are observed with real records.
No overlapping source is promoted or summed without a validated rule.
tasks.next_action: Run the physical-device gate after Apple signing and device setup exist.
tasks.blocker: Apple signing, TestFlight/device setup, and real source evidence are external to the current environment.

tasks.summary: Expand Polar history and telemetry only from an original export or proven event mapping.
acceptance: Original source evidence covers the intended historical period.
Telemetry attaches to the correct canonical workout without creating a duplicate session.
Ambiguous mappings remain held.
tasks.next_action: Audit a real Polar export when it is available.
tasks.blocker: The required original export and event-level evidence are not present.

tasks.summary: Expand laboratory coverage and specialized parsing from original Fleury/Einstein files.
acceptance: Original files are preserved privately.
Parser output is validated against real samples without inventing marker, unit, reference, or date.
Direct integration, if pursued, uses an authorized and technically supported path.
tasks.next_action: Validate a specialized parser only after representative original files are available.
tasks.blocker: Representative originals and a confirmed direct integration path are unavailable.

tasks.summary: Preserve the distinction between document inventory metadata and original files that have not been supplied.
acceptance: Metadata is never presented as an openable original.
A parser or reconciliation task is created only when the corresponding original exists.
tasks.next_action: Create a concrete task when an original document is supplied and needed.
tasks.blocker: There is no safe executable change without the original bytes.

tasks.summary: Add historical measurements only from dated, consented source evidence.
acceptance: Every new record has a dated source and provenance.
Missing measurements are not reconstructed from targets or nearby dates.
tasks.next_action: Create an import task when a dated source is supplied.
tasks.blocker: No additional dated source is currently available.

tasks.summary: Enable leaked-password protection in the Supabase Auth settings.
acceptance: The Supabase security advisor no longer reports leaked-password protection as disabled.
tasks.next_action: Enable leaked-password protection in the Supabase Auth dashboard, then rerun the security advisor.
tasks.blocker: The connected project tools do not expose this Auth dashboard setting.
